caption: The drawing shows a curved staircase with a reddish-brown handrail and light beige vertical balusters. The steps are brown and rise in a spiral shape from the bottom left of the image to the upper right. The staircase is enclosed by beige walls with a smooth surface, and the floor at the base is a similar beige color to the walls. The composition focuses on the elegant curve of the stairs and handrail, with light and shadow used to define the structure, and the image is framed by a rectangular border. The signature "Geo. V. Vezolles" appears in the lower right corner.
title: Shaker Spiral Staircase
